name: Tia: Weird Hunter
storyline:
A Hand-Painted Journey Into the Unknown

Begin your adventure in a finely crafted hand-drawn world. Explore the “Faceless City” as the Scythe Maiden, uncover the truth behind the mutiny of the Tomorrow’s Flower Legion, and fight to save the Weirdkin.

The Faceless City

This strange metropolis is shrouded in black mist year-round. Its districts are isolated, with only the societal elite allowed to travel between them via “trains.” Ordinary residents are confined to fragmented zones, unable to grasp the city's full structure. As a result, the people have come to call it the Faceless City.

Each region, shaped by the ever-present mist, has developed its own distinct geography, culture, and atmosphere. Your journey through these divided zones will be one of mystery, beauty, and danger.
summary: Welcome to Tia: Weird Hunter, a hand-drawn 2D action RPG. Unleash fast, fluid combos, and take on fierce boss battles that will test your reflexes and skills. Play as the mysterious Scythe Maiden as you explore the vivid, fantastical city known as the Faceless City.
